hermes.entrypoint:
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "harness-evals" / "vendor" / "hermes"
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
workspace = Path(os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_WORKSPACE"])
home = workspace / ".harness-state"
home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["HERMES_HOME"] = str(home)
os.environ["TERMINAL_CWD"] = str(workspace)
os.environ["TERMINAL_ENV"] = "local"
os.environ["HERMES_QUIET"] = "1"
os.environ["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
os.environ["HERMES_DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
proxy = os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_PROXY_URL"]
model = os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_MODEL"]
config = {
    "model": {"default": model, "provider": "custom", "base_url": proxy},
    "agent": {"reasoning_effort": "high"},
    "auxiliary": {"title_generation": {"enabled": True, "model_upgrade_enabled": False}},
    "custom_providers": [{"name": "fixture", "base_url": proxy, "api_key": "fixture-local-proxy", "extra_body": {"max_tokens": 8192}}],
    "terminal": {"backend": "local", "cwd": str(workspace)},
}
(home / "config.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
from cli import main

main(query=Path(os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_PROMPT_FILE"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), oneshot=True, quiet=True, toolsets="terminal,file,code_execution", model=model, provider="custom", base_url=proxy, api_key="fixture-local-proxy", reasoning="high", max_turns=60, ignore_rules=True)

launch: Use pinned Hermes editable Python environment and Bun1.4.2. Set upstream credential only in parent environment HARNESS_UPSTREAM_KEY; runner strips it before adapters. Fresh home/cwd per trial; fixture tokens are placeholders.
launch_note: Archived gateway authentication is substituted with an inert fixture placeholder; set the isolated gateway to the same token. Upstream provider credentials are never recorded.
